task_due_idx.name: task_due_idx
task_due_idx.where: "task"."deleted_at" is null and "task"."due_date" is not null

task_queue_idx.name: task_queue_idx
task_queue_idx.where: "task"."deleted_at" is null and "task"."status" = 'todo' and "task"."assignee_kind" = 'agent' and "task"."work" is null

task_assignee_check.name: task_assignee_check
task_assignee_check.value: ("task"."assignee_kind" is null and "task"."assignee_id" is null) or ("task"."assignee_kind" in ('user', 'agent') and "task"."assignee_id" is not null)
